name: LARS
description: Layer-wise Adaptive Rate Scaling (LARS) optimizer applying a per-parameter trust ratio with weight decay. foreach, fused, and capturable are not claimed; DDP/FSDP/ZeRO compatibility matches a plain torch optimizer step on local parameters.

parameters.backend_options: forwarded to torch.optim.LARS when available; otherwise supports trust_coefficient and eps

examples.title: Optimize parameters with LARS
examples.code:
import torch
from topologies.implementations.optimizers.lars import lars

parameters = [torch.nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(2.0))]
optimizer = lars(parameters, lr=0.05)
loss = (parameters[0] - 1.0).square()
loss.backward()
optimizer.step()
